name: Propylthiouracil
description: A thionamide that inhibits thyroid peroxidase and also blocks peripheral T4 to T3 conversion, approved for hyperthyroidism. Carries a boxed warning for severe hepatic injury.

systems.note: Inhibits hormone synthesis and peripheral conversion; the labelled indication.
Boxed warning for severe hepatic injury including hepatic failure.

monitors.why: Boxed warning for severe hepatic injury; the defining monitoring parameter for this drug.
Titration parameter that responds faster than TSH.
Lags the free hormones early in therapy.
